<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/01-header.png?raw=true" alt="Identica Premium Provider, Premium Provider. Players with a premium Minecraft account join without a password and keep their identity when they change their name, as a provider for Identica. Runs on Velocity and BungeeCord. Supported versions: 1.7+." align="left">
<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/02-board-dependencies-information.png?raw=true" alt="Dependencies &amp; Information. Identica: A provider for Identica. Put it into Identica&#x27;s providers folder, from the same release as Identica. Mojang: Accounts are checked against Mojang; answers are cached for 5 minutes and shared between proxies with Redis. Good to know: A player who joins under a premium account&#x27;s name without a premium login is refused once; their next join from the same address goes to the next provider." align="left">
<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/03-feature-names-that-belong-to-their-owner.png?raw=true" alt="Names that belong to their owner. A premium account owns its username, and Identica follows it. Name changes: a player renamed at Mojang keeps their account under the new name. Protection: anyone joining with a premium account&#x27;s name has to log in as premium. Priority: a premium owner takes their name from an account that does not own it, which is renamed." align="left">
<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/04-feature-switch-either-way.png?raw=true" alt="Switch either way. Players move their own account to Premium and away again, without losing it. To Premium: a command moves an existing account to Premium, after confirmation. Away again: another provider&#x27;s move command takes the account back." align="left">
<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/05-grid-supports-identica-s-features.png?raw=true" alt="Supports Identica&#x27;s features. Verification: A second step such as TOTP after the login. Recognition: Returning players skip the full login while their signals match. Sentinel: Watches for repeated or risky actions. Restriction: Lets admins temporarily block new joins through this provider." align="left">
<img src="https://github.com/whereareiam/Identica/blob/dev/.github/assets/provider/premium/render/06-steps-getting-started.png?raw=true" alt="Getting started. Step 1, Install: Install Identica, then put Identica-Premium into its providers folder. Step 2, Start: Start the proxy once, then stop it. Step 3, Enable: Enable the provider in Identica&#x27;s configuration and start the proxy." align="left">
